question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of sustainable utensils?
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Non-recyclability'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, **'Non-recyclability'** is not a characteristic of sustainable utensils.
 
• As this is clearly mentioned in the passage: **'These utensils can be reused multiple times, further reducing waste. Many sustainable options are durable and washable, making them a viable long-term solution'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'****Biodegradability'** is a feature of sustainable utensils.
 
• **'Reusability'** is also a feature of sustainable utensils.
 
• **'Durability' **is also a feature of sustainable utensils.
